project_name: HLMC'S ENTERPRISE & SERVICES, INC. (H&SI) x APSA UK LTD

brand_identity.name: HLMC'S ENTERPRISE & SERVICES, INC.
brand_identity.positioning: Award-winning global trading house meets ultra-modern tech brand.

theme.toggle_mechanism: Header pill toggle with smooth theme transition (0.3s ease)

rules: Use deep_navy (#04163A) as primary dark background base.
Use brand_red (#E3161B) and brand_green (#0E7A34) sparingly as dynamic sparks, CTA highlights, and trade node triggers.
Use amber_gold (#FDB95B) and soft_gold (#FFD68A) for metallic typography, glowing trade routes, status badges, and luxury real estate highlights.
Never use pure black #000000. Always tint dark surfaces with deep navy #04163A.

headlines.style: High-contrast serif with letter-spacing tracking-tight or tracking-widest for overlines
headlines.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-extrabold tracking-tight leading-none

section_numbers.style: Oversized stencil/mono outline numbers (e.g. 01, 02, 03) rendered in soft_gold/20 at 6xl to 8xl size behind titles.

spacing_and_layout.bento_grid_rules: Tetris grid with 12-column base (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12), gap-8, mixing tall, wide, and square ratio cards with 3D tilt.
spacing_and_layout.padding_guard: Containers with borders MUST have internal padding p-6 or p-8 to prevent text collisions.

animations_and_motion.lenis_smooth_scroll: Enabled across all pages for luxury inertia scrolling
animations_and_motion.preloader: SVGs draw stroke on H&SI circular seal (red outer ring, green lettering draw, gold monogram glow) with split counter 0% to 100%
animations_and_motion.hero_globe: Three.js / WebGL particle globe with interactive camera rotation and glowing bezier trade route arcs linking Philippines (Manila), Thailand (Bangkok), Vietnam (Ho Chi Minh City), and UK (London)
animations_and_motion.headline_reveal: Masked line-by-line / letter-by-letter stagger reveal using Framer Motion
animations_and_motion.custom_cursor: Interactive custom cursor with inner amber gold dot + lagging outer glass ring expanding on hover
animations_and_motion.tilt_glass_cards: 3D tilt glassmorphism cards with mouse-aware sheen and rotating gradient border
animations_and_motion.horizontal_product_gallery: Pinned horizontal scroll section showcasing core commodity lines
animations_and_motion.marquee_tickers: Dual marquee tickers running smooth continuous scroll for Commodity Ticker, Real Clients, and Strategic Partners
animations_and_motion.count_up_numbers: Scroll-triggered count-up animations for key metrics ($500M+ Volume, 4 Global Hubs, 100+ Trade Partners, 100% SEC Compliant)
animations_and_motion.reduced_motion: Full fallback with standard fade-in for prefers-reduced-motion

hero_particle_globe.library: Three.js / React Three Fiber / Canvas 2D WebGL fallback
hero_particle_globe.arcs: Animated glowing bezier curves connecting Manila to London, Bangkok, and Vietnam with traveling particle pulses.

Dark luxury footer with rotating H&SI seal SVG, quick links, compliance statement, and back-to-top progress ring.

testing_and_qa.data_testid_convention: All interactive elements MUST have explicit data-testid attributes in kebab-case (e.g. data-testid='inquire-now-button', data-testid='product-filter-chip-rice', data-testid='credentials-lightbox-sec').

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute for stable testing.
